# C4 audit — existing rule, two-year replay with net after costs (generated by c4Audit.ts)

Rule: fakeUpPaperCore.isPaperSignal — fake-up CONFIRMED (live detectFakeMoveTF, 4 bars, 0.04 %) at an OWNER S/R level + call writing (ATM CE OI ↑ and CE premium ↓ over the 4-bar window) + level touched ≥ 30 min earlier (within 0.15 ATR). Entry at the confirming 5-min close, ATM PE. Index exit (fakeMoveGrid.score1to1): stop = 4-bar high (≥ 0.25 ATR away), target 1 : 1, 60 min. Option: ATM PE bought at the entry minute, sold at the index-exit minute. Costs max(₹0.5, 0.25 %) per side + ₹40 / lot; conservative + 0.5 % per side. NIFTY lot 75, SENSEX lot 20. ₹ per lot.

Grid split used when the rule was SELECTED: DEV = first ⅔ of sessions (selection), VAL = last ⅓ (check). The rule was picked from 22,304 combinations, so these numbers carry selection bias; only the paper test from 26 Oct is truly unseen.
